verses.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος Τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν Θεῷ Πατρὶ ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Paulos kai Silouanos kai Timotheos Tē ekklēsia Thessalonikeōn en Theō Patri hēmōn kai Kyriō Iēsou Christō
verses.literal: Paul Silvanus and Timothy To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: PAULO, e Silvano, e Timóteo, à igreja dos tessalonicenses, em Deus nosso Pai, e no Senhor Jesus Cristo:

verses.original: Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Graça e paz a vós da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e da do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστεῖν ὀφείλομεν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἀδελφοί καθὼς ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὅτι ὑπεραυξάνει ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καὶ πλεονάζει ἡ ἀγάπη ἑνὸς ἑκάστου πάντων ὑμῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Eucharistein opheilomen tō Theō pantote peri hymōn adelphoi kathōs axion estin hoti hyperauxanei hē pistis hymōn kai pleonazei hē agapē henos hekastou pantōn hymōn eis allēlous
verses.literal: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time brothers as is fitting because your faith is growing more and more and your love for one another is increasing
verses.literalPt: Sempre devemos, irmãos, dar graças a Deus por vós, como é justo, porque a vossa fé cresce muitíssimo e o amor de cada um de vós aumenta de uns para com os outros,

verses.original: ὥστε αὐτοὺς ἡμᾶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐνκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑπομονῆς ὑμῶν καὶ πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς διωγμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ταῖς θλίψεσιν αἷς ἀνέχεσθε
verses.transliteration: hōste autous hēmas en hymin enkauchasthai en tais ekklēsiais tou Theou hyper tēs hypomonēs hymōn kai pisteōs en pasin tois diōgmois hymōn kai tais thlipsesin hais anechesthe
verses.literal: That is why we boast among God’s churches - about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring
verses.literalPt: De maneira que nós mesmos nos gloriamos de vós nas igrejas de Deus por causa da vossa paciência e fé, e em todas as vossas perseguições e aflições que suportais;

verses.original: Ἔνδειγμα τῆς δικαίας κρίσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναι ὑμᾶς τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε
verses.transliteration: Endeigma tēs dikaias kriseōs tou Theou eis to kataxiōthēnai hymas tēs basileias tou Theou hyper hēs kai paschete
verses.literal: All this is clear evidence - of God’s righteous judgment And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God for which you are suffering
verses.literalPt: Prova clara do justo juízo de Deus, para que sejais havidos por dignos do reino de Deus, pelo qual também padeceis;

verses.original: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ Θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς θλῖψιν
verses.transliteration: eiper dikaion para Theō antapodounai tois thlibousin hymas thlipsin
verses.literal: After all it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you
verses.literalPt: Se de fato é justo diante de Deus que dê em paga tribulação aos que vos atribulam,

verses.original: καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις ἄνεσιν μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ μετ’ ἀγγέλων δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hymin tois thlibomenois anesin meth’ hēmōn en tē apokalypsei tou Kyriou Iēsou ap’ ouranou met’ angelōn dynameōs autou
verses.literal: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
verses.literalPt: E a vós, que sois atribulados, descanso conosco, quando se manifestar o Senhor Jesus desde o céu com os anjos do seu poder,

verses.original: ἐν πυρὶ φλογός διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσιν Θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: en pyri phlogos didontos ekdikēsin tois mē eidosin Theon kai tois mē hypakouousin tō euangeliō tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou
verses.literal: in blazing fire inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus
verses.literalPt: Como labareda de fogo, tomando vingança dos que não conhecem a Deus e dos que não obedecem ao evangelho de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;

verses.original: οἵτινες δίκην τίσουσιν ὄλεθρον αἰώνιον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoitines dikēn tisousin olethron aiōnion apo prosōpou tou Kyriou kai apo tēs doxēs tēs ischyos autou
verses.literal: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might
verses.literalPt: Os quais, por castigo, padecerão eterna perdição, ante a face do Senhor e a glória do seu poder,

verses.original: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ὅτι ἐπιστεύθη τὸ μαρτύριον ἡμῶν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ
verses.transliteration: hotan elthē endoxasthēnai en tois hagiois autou kai thaumasthēnai en pasin tois pisteusasin hoti episteuthē to martyrion hēmōn eph’ hymas en tē hēmera ekeinē
verses.literal: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed including you who have believed our testimony
verses.literalPt: Quando vier para ser glorificado nos seus santos, e para se fazer admirável naquele dia em todos os que crêem (porquanto o nosso testemunho foi crido entre vós).

verses.original: Εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἵνα ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς κλήσεως ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν εὐδοκίαν ἀγαθωσύνης καὶ ἔργον πίστεως ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: Eis ho kai proseuchometha pantote peri hymōn hina hymas axiōsē tēs klēseōs ho Theos hēmōn kai plērōsē pasan eudokian agathōsynēs kai ergon pisteōs en dynamei
verses.literal: To this end . . . . . . we always pray . . . for you that our God will count you worthy of His calling and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith
verses.literalPt: Por isso também rogamos sempre por vós, para que o nosso Deus vos faça dignos da sua vocação, e cumpra todo o desejo da sua bondade, e a obra da fé com poder;

verses.original: ὅπως ἐνδοξασθῇ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ κατὰ τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hopōs endoxasthē to onoma tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou en hymin kai hymeis en autō kata tēn charin tou Theou hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you and you in Him according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Para que o nome de nosso SENHOR Jesus Cristo seja em vós glorificado, e vós nele, segundo a graça de nosso Deus e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
